description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Ice], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Ice Stalker Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ice
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Ice Stalker Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Ice Stalker (Black Magic/Witch) after using a Black Magic/Witch ability

description.name: Ice Stalker (Black Magic)
description.text: Two single attacks (2.01 each), grants [Magical High Quick Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Magical High Quick Cast 2
description.text: Cast speed x3.00 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage

description.name: Ice Stalker (Witch)
description.text: Two single attacks (2.01 each), grants [Buff Ice 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Buff Ice 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 10%, cumulable
